name: beluga
tagline: AI native IDE designed around AI first development
description: Beluga is a desktop application that integrates AI agents into a development environment. It creates a separate worktree, branch, and agent for each task, allowing multiple tasks to run side by side. Users can see live steps, screenshots, tables, charts, and diagrams generated by the agents, and can intervene mid‑run. The tool supports collaboration by letting agents on different machines communicate, and it can be run on a server for remote access via a browser or phone. It runs on macOS, Linux, and Windows and is distributed under the MIT license.
best_for: Developers who want AI assistance while coding
Teams collaborating on code with AI agents
Users needing live visualizations of data within an IDE
